value: H.R.2034, known as the Income-Driven Student Loan Forgiveness Act, proposes the forgiveness of outstanding federal student loan balances by the Department of Education for eligible borrowers. To qualify, individuals must have a federal student loan in repayment, have filed recent tax returns, been recently employed, and meet specific income requirements, such as an adjusted gross income of $100,000 or less for single filers. Borrowers must submit an application, though previously made payments are not refundable. A key provision of the bill is the exclusion of discharged student loan debt from an individual's gross income for tax purposes.
